title: Legal challenge to Palestine Action ban can go ahead, court rules
summary: Judges reject Home Office attempt to block judicial review of group’s proscription under Terrorism Act A legal challenge to the ban on Palestine Action can go ahead next month after the court of appeal rejected the Home Office’s attempt to block the case. On Friday, three judges, led by the lady chief justice, upheld Mr Justice Chamberlain’s decision to grant the Palestine Action co-founder Huda Ammori a judicial review of the group’s proscription under the Terrorism Act. title: John Bolton expected to surrender to authorities on Friday after being indicted – US politics live
summary: Eighteen-count indictment of former Trump adviser handed down by federal grand jury in Maryland as US president calls ex-ally a ‘bad guy’ John Bolton, the former national security adviser to Donald Trump who has since become one of the US president’s biggest Republican critics, was expected to surrender to the authorities on Friday and make an initial appearance in court to face criminal charges that he mishandled classified information.
